name: Acceptance narrator
description: The acceptance run's plain plugin with `voices.use`: its `narrate` command asks the run's tone voice to transcribe a short recording and gets the text back as its own data. Its child, `nosy`, has no `voices.use`: the same ask is refused.

commands.name: narrate
commands.description: Asks the run's tone voice to transcribe a short recording; answers with the text it got.
